channel.title: OpenAI Research & Releases
channel.description: Latest research papers and model releases from OpenAI

item.title: Advisory Group on Mathematics and Artificial Intelligence
item.description: OpenAI is working with an independent Advisory Group on Mathematics and Artificial Intelligence to guide the review and communication of emerging AI results.

item.title: Higgsfield AI ships new video features in a day with GPT-6 Astra
item.description: With GPT-6 Astra, Higgsfield AI makes video ad creation easier for small businesses and brings new creative tools to market faster.

item.title: Building standards for the next phase of AI
item.description: OpenAI outlines a path to shared global AI standards, calling for coordinated evaluation, reporting, and governance to improve safety.

item.title: Expanding OpenAI Academy with new learning paths
item.description: Explore new OpenAI Academy learning paths for employees, developers, leaders, educators, and students to build and demonstrate practical AI skills.

item.title: How V7 gives AI agents institutional memory
item.description: Using GPT-5.6, V7 turns scattered company files into context agents can use to complete complex, source-linked work.

item.title: Introducing the Australian Youth Safety Blueprint
item.description: OpenAI introduces the Australian Youth Safety Blueprint, a six-pillar roadmap for safer AI experiences that protect and empower young people.

item.title: How Cooley is accelerating IPO work with ChatGPT
item.description: Cooley built GO Public with ChatGPT Work to bring intelligence to the IPO process, helping lawyers surface issues earlier and focus judgment where it matters most.

item.title: Introducing Astra for Law
item.description: OpenAI for Law brings frontier intelligence for law, custom firm workflows, connected legal data sources, and legal-grade controls for confidential client work.

item.title: Our framework for reporting model misalignment
item.description: OpenAI shares a framework for tracking, investigating, and disclosing model misalignment, alongside six reports of unexpected or concerning model behavior.

item.title: Helping older adults use AI in everyday life
item.description: OpenAI and AARP are bringing free, hands-on ChatGPT workshops to 1,000 older adults across 10 U.S. cities to build practical AI skills safely.

item.title: Reimagining advertising with AI
item.description: Explore new AI-powered advertising experiences from OpenAI, including Sponsored Agents, tools for marketers, and integrations with HubSpot and Shopify.

item.title: Hex turns complex analysis into visual reports with GPT‑6 Astra
item.description: GPT-6 Astra helps Hex’s data agents turn answers into interactive visualizations that employees are proud to share.

item.title: How to connect AI usage to business value
item.description: Learn how ChatGPT Work and Codex analytics help teams understand AI usage and spend, identify training needs, and connect adoption to business outcomes.

item.title: How workers are unlocking new ways of working
item.description: New OpenAI Economic Research shows how workers use AI beyond traditional roles and which new activities become recurring parts of their work.

item.title: How Fyxer built an AI executive assistant people trust
item.description: Fyxer uses OpenAI models, fine-tuning, memory, and real user feedback to organize inboxes and draft emails in each user’s voice.

item.title: Perplexity trusts GPT-6 Astra with end-to-end systems
item.description: Perplexity uses Astra to write communications, change software, and monitor production systems, and checks in much less frequently than with earlier models.

item.title: Cognition helps Devin test its own work with GPT‑6 Astra
item.description: GPT‑6 Astra improves Devin’s ability to test software and show that it works, with the goal of helping engineers review less code and ship more.

item.title: Rapidly scaling online storage to serve over 1 billion ChatGPT users
item.description: Learn how OpenAI evolved Habitat from a Python library into a globally distributed storage platform serving 1 billion ChatGPT users and 22M requests per second.

item.title: How a researcher uses Codex and ChatGPT to search for new antimicrobial molecules
item.description: César de la Fuente’s lab uses Codex and ChatGPT to search living and extinct genomes for antimicrobial candidates to fight drug-resistant infections.

item.title: Now everyone can put data to work
item.description: Meet the Data agent in ChatGPT Work. Connect company data, uncover insights, and build interactive dashboards with AI using natural language.
